<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" style="color-scheme:light">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light">
<script>document.documentElement.classList.add("js")</script>
<title>Vasylyna – Nail Technician</title>
<meta name="description" content="Gel manicures, extensions and custom nail art by Vasylyna.">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bodoni+Moda:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..96,400;1,6..96,400&family=Jost:wght@300;400&family=Great+Vibes&display=swap">
<style>
:root{--bg:#fff;--ink:#1c1c1f;--muted:#76767c;--line:#ece8e8;--soft:#faf6f6;--blush:#f0d9d9;--sage:#a9b79a;--clay:#d9a5a8;--mocha:#1c1c1f;
--script:"Great Vibes","Snell Roundhand","Apple Chancery",cursive;--photo:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");--p2:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");--p3:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,");--serif:"Bodoni Moda",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;--sans:"Jost",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;
color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 72px);scroll-behavior:smooth;background:#fff}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:300 17px/1.7 var(--sans);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:#fff;z-index:30}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--clay);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 28px}
h1,h2,h3,p{margin:0}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.01em}
h2{font-size:clamp(34px,4.4vw,54px)}
header{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:40;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(12px)}
.bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:76px}
.brand{font:italic 400 30px var(--serif)}
nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:34px;font-size:15px}
nav a:not(.btn){color:var(--muted);transition:color .2s}nav a:not(.btn):hover{color:var(--ink)}
.btn{display:inline-block;padding:14px 32px;border-radius:999px;font-size:15px;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.02em;background:var(--mocha);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--mocha);transition:background .25s,color .25s,transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .3s}
.btn:hover{background:#fff;color:var(--mocha);transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.04);box-shadow:0 12px 26px rgba(28,28,31,.18)}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(-1px) scale(1.01)}
.btn.ghost{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-color:#d8d4d4}
.btn.ghost:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}
.hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;padding:64px 0 110px}
.hero h1{font:400 clamp(60px,8.2vw,108px)/1.02 var(--script);letter-spacing:0;margin-bottom:28px}
.hero p{max-width:420px;color:var(--muted);font-size:18px;margin-bottom:38px}
.cta{display:flex;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.photo{aspect-ratio:4/5;width:100%;max-width:470px;justify-self:end;border-radius:20px;background:var(--photo) 45% 50%/cover no-repeat;box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(28,28,31,.14)}
section{padding:110px 0}
.head{margin-bottom:56px}
.head p{color:var(--muted);margin-top:16px;max-width:460px}
.row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.1fr;gap:32px;padding:36px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line);align-items:baseline}
.row:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.row h3{font-size:clamp(28px,3.2vw,40px)}
.row p{color:var(--muted);max-width:440px}
.looks{background:var(--soft)}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px}
.tile{margin:0;--c:#ccc}
.arch.ph{padding:0;background-size:cover;background-position:30% 50%;background-repeat:no-repeat}
.arch{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 20%,#fff);border-radius:16px;aspect-ratio:3/4;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:16% 16% 10%}
.arch svg{width:100%;height:auto}
.tile figcaption{padding-top:16px;font:400 20px var(--serif);text-align:center}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.75fr 1.25fr;gap:80px;align-items:center}
.mono{aspect-ratio:4/5;background:var(--p3) 50% 55%/cover no-repeat;border-radius:20px}
.about p{color:var(--muted);max-width:500px;margin-top:22px}
.book{text-align:center;background:var(--soft);border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
.book h2{max-width:620px;margin:0 auto}
.book p{color:var(--muted);max-width:440px;margin:20px auto 38px}
.book .cta{justify-content:center}
.info{margin-top:48px;font-size:15px;color:var(--muted)}
footer{padding:32px 0;text-align:center;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted)}
.js .rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}
.js .rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
header{transition:box-shadow .3s}header.s{box-shadow:0 1px 0 var(--line)}
.row h3{transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.row:hover h3{transform:translateX(8px)}
.arch{transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .5s}.tile:hover .arch{transform:translateY(-8px);box-shadow:0 18px 30px rgba(28,28,31,.1)}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.js .rv{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}html{scroll-behavior:auto}.btn:hover,.tile:hover .arch,.row:hover h3{transform:none}}
@media (max-width:860px){.hero,.about{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero{padding:32px 0 72px}.photo{justify-self:center}.about{gap:40px}.mono{max-width:260px}.grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:10px}section{padding:76px 0}}
@media (max-width:640px){nav a:not(.btn){display:none}.grid{gap:16px}}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true"><defs><g id="n"><path d="M30 2C44 28 56 70 56 112C56 128 44 138 30 138C16 138 4 128 4 112C4 70 16 28 30 2Z"/><path d="M16 74C16 58 20 44 25 33C27 55 27 82 25 106C19 102 16 92 16 74Z" fill="#fff" opacity=".4"/></g></defs></svg>
<header><div class="wrap bar">
<a class="brand" href="#top">Vasylyna</a>
<nav><a href="#services">Services</a><a href="#looks">Looks</a><a href="#about">About</a><a class="btn" href="#book">Book now</a></nav>
</div></header>

<main id="top">
<div class="wrap hero">
<div>
<h1>Nails with a quiet kind of luxury.</h1>
<p>Gel manicures, extensions and custom nail art by Vasylyna, in soft, natural tones that suit every hand.</p>
<div class="cta"><a class="btn" href="#book">Book an appointment</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#looks">See the looks</a></div>
</div>
<div class="photo" role="img" aria-label="Vasylyna’s hands with a soft nude gel manicure"></div>
</div>

<section id="services"><div class="wrap">
<div class="head"><h2>Services</h2></div>
<div>
<div class="row"><h3>Gel manicure</h3><p>Shaped, prepped and finished in long-wear gel with a glass-like shine.</p></div>
<div class="row"><h3>Extensions</h3><p>Sculpted length in almond, coffin or square, or a short natural set.</p></div>
<div class="row"><h3>Custom nail art</h3><p>Hand-painted details, chrome and cat-eye finishes, or clean minimal designs.</p></div>
</div>
</div></section>

<section class="looks" id="looks"><div class="wrap">
<div class="head"><h2>Signature looks</h2><p>A few of Vasylyna’s favourite finishes.</p></div>
<div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
</div></section>

<section id="about"><div class="wrap about">
<div class="mono" role="img" aria-label="Vasylyna’s soft almond nude manicure"></div>
<div>
<h2>Meet Vasylyna</h2>
<p>Great nails should feel as good as they look. Vasylyna focuses on healthy prep, precise shaping and designs made around your hands and your taste, whether you want something understated or a full statement set.</p>
</div>
</div></section>

<section class="book" id="book"><div class="wrap">
<h2>Ready for your next set?</h2>
<p>Send a message with the look you have in mind and Vasylyna will find a time that works.</p>
<div class="cta"><a class="btn" href="#">Book an appointment</a><a class="btn ghost" href="#">Message on Instagram</a></div>
<div class="info">Your phone number &nbsp;&nbsp;|&nbsp;&nbsp; @yourinstagram &nbsp;&nbsp;|&nbsp;&nbsp; Your studio address</div>
</div></section>
</main>

<footer>© 2026 Vasylyna</footer>

<script>
var looks=[["French Tip","#e6cdc8","p2"],["Sage Cat-Eye","#8fa183"],["Mauve Glaze","#b39aa6"],["Rosé Ombré","#d9a5a8"]];
var g=document.getElementById("grid");
looks.forEach(function(l){
  var f=document.createElement("figure");f.className="tile";f.style.setProperty("--c",l[1]);
  f.innerHTML='<div class="arch"><svg viewBox="0 0 130 120" aria-hidden="true">'+
  '<use href="#n" style="fill:var(--c)" transform="translate(8 30) rotate(-7 21 49) scale(.7)"/>'+
  '<use href="#n" style="fill:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 70%,#fff)" transform="translate(44 14) scale(.7)"/>'+
  '<use href="#n" style="fill:var(--c)" transform="translate(80 32) rotate(7 21 49) scale(.7)"/>'+
  '</svg></div><figcaption>'+l[0]+'</figcaption>';
  if(l[2]){var a=f.querySelector(".arch");a.innerHTML="";a.classList.add("ph");a.style.backgroundImage="var(--"+l[2]+")";a.setAttribute("role","img");a.setAttribute("aria-label",l[0]+" manicure")}
  g.appendChild(f);
});
var els=document.querySelectorAll(".hero > *,.head,.row,.tile,.about > *,.book .wrap > *");
els.forEach(function(e){e.classList.add("rv");var i=Array.prototype.indexOf.call(e.parentNode.children,e);e.style.transitionDelay=Math.min(i,4)*90+"ms"});
if("IntersectionObserver" in window){
  var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(x){if(x.isIntersecting){x.target.classList.add("in");io.unobserve(x.target)}})},{threshold:.1,rootMargin:"0px 0px -6% 0px"});
  els.forEach(function(e){io.observe(e)});
}else{els.forEach(function(e){e.classList.add("in")})}
var hd=document.querySelector("header");
addEventListener("scroll",function(){hd.classList.toggle("s",scrollY>10)},{passive:true});
</script>
</body>
</html>
